messages:
alex: FYI seeing a spike of pod evictions on gpu nodes in us-east1 after last night's RDMA driver rollout. Kubelet net-probe is reporting failures and evicting pods (OOM? no, network checks).
sara: Which probe is failing? ICMP/udp/tcp?
alex: The kubelet logs show the node net-probe short-circuit: 'net-probe: probe failed to 10.0.8.1: icmp timeout' repeated. A bunch of pods went NotReady -> Evicted.
devin: Can you paste a tail of the kubelet log and the output of `ip link show` from one of the affected nodes?
alex: pasted logs from node gpu-08: ``[kubelet] 2026-03-17T04:12:11Z netprobe: probe to 10.0.8.1 failed: no response`` ``dmesg: mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0: firmware fw 19.24.0 loaded, HCA reset``
ryan: That mlx5 message aligns with the RDMA firmware bump. We pushed an HCA firmware update clusterwide last night. Could be NIC offload interaction with XDP/eBPF dropping small probe packets.
sara: I ran `ip link` and MTU on the RDMA interface is 65520 (expected), but on the veths it's 1500. Probe uses 1500-sized packets? Fragmentation could be happening.
devin: Also saw a ton of `ICMP frag needed` in syslog on one host. If probes set DF flag, fragments get dropped, net-probe sees timeouts.
alex: ops-bot alerted evictions at 04:14: `kubelet: node gpu-08 unresponsive to net-check, initiating evictions`.
ryan: Short term mitigation: set `--eviction-max-pod-grace-period` higher and bump `node-status-update-frequency` so transient net-probe flaps don't immediately evict. Also schedule a rollback of the RDMA firmware on a small canary to confirm.
sara: Agreed. I'm patching the Dedicated GPU nodepool to exclude the updated build and will cordon/evict gracefully.
devin: We should also adjust the probe itself. Our net-probe (daemonset) uses `ping -M do -s 1400` to test big MTU path. Let's change to `ping -s 600` (no DF) for a bit and re-evaluate. That will avoid fragmentation issues while we investigate.
ryan: Good call. If eBPF/XDP is redirecting large packets to userspace and drops them, small probe windows may be safer.
alex: I've pushed a quick config change to the net-probe DS to use `-s 600` and lowered probe rate from 5s -> 10s. Will monitor for the next 10 min.
infra-bot: alert: gpu-pool evictions decreased from 23 -> 3 in 10m after probe config update.
sara: Nice. Let's keep the rollback plan for the RDMA firmware. Also add a postmortem note: cause hypothesis = HCA firmware + eBPF offload causing probe fragmentation -> kubelet net-check false positives.
devin: Follow-ups: (1) revert firmware on 2 nodes as canary, (2) run `tcpdump -s0 -w` during probe to confirm DF/ICMP frag, (3) consider probe fallback to TCP connect for future checks.
ryan: I'll coordinate firmware rollback with hardware vendor and ops. Tagging @oncall for awareness.
alex: Thanks team — will update thread with results from the canary rollback.
